method: Profile likelihood: the parameter is fixed on a grid and every other parameter is re-optimised at each point (differential evolution, then L-BFGS-B). The loss is unpenalised MSE on the percentile-anchored outcome, matching the shipped fit.
verdict: The loss rises monotonically as alpha grows, so it is minimised at or below the smallest value tested (0.001). No interior optimum exists: the parameter is not identified on this panel, and the optimiser is not choosing a value so much as running to whatever floor is imposed.
